title: DPW Announces Road Reconstruction Project on North Geddes Street
summary: The Department of Public Works announced a road reconstruction project on North Geddes Street scheduled for November 3-4, 2026, involving paving between Spencer Street and Erie Boulevard. Single-lane alternating traffic with flaggers will be in place; completion is expected within 48 hours contingent on weather.
